title: Young Tuxedo and Eddie Jackson's original Tuxedo band
summary: Howard says he played with the Young Tuxedo and led the original Tuxedo band under Eddie Jackson, naming its members.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you play in the Young Tuxedo ever?
Yeah, I played with John, quite a while. Any of the other bands? I played with Eddie Jackson, when he had the original Tuxedo.
Yeah, the original Tuxedo. Yeah. Me Pazzo and Maurice Duran. I was leading that band. Well who else was in that band?
Because I don't know much about them.

Well George was, he worked in the band, and I was leading that band. Was it Celestan? No, Celestan wasn't, give up Eddie Jackson, had the band then. Eddie Jackson, one of the best tuba that we all know ever lived.

He was a great guy. You see, he was wonderful. And one of the three trumpets, I know that for sure. Henry Harden played in that band. Earl Fusche played the saxophone. Trombone, man. I believe it was Yanko. Anyway, I know it was good, but everybody was right. It was a good band. Black Happy played. That was a good band. Yeah. That's right. Black Happy played. That, mostly he played.
